02 / Ways of makingAn image learns to move.

Ways of making.

Find the unexpected

Image.

A simple material.
A different point of view.
Suddenly, another world.

I start with a fold, a surface, a trace of light.
Through material and composition, I look for
the moment something familiar becomes unfamiliar.
Give it character

Motion.

A hesitation. A turn.
A moment of weightlessness.
The image finds its own rhythm.

I shape the pauses as carefully as the movement.
Weight, tension and timing turn a simple form
into something with a personality of its own.
Leave room for someone else

Interaction.

Your presence changes the picture.

One material.
Endless possibilities.
Light reveals formScroll to find the light

Image.

Find the unexpected. A simple material, seen in a different light.

Motion.

Give it character. Anticipation, rhythm and a moment of weightlessness.

Interaction.

Invite the viewer. Let presence and perspective change the work.
